verses.translation: For the end, a Song of David, to Idithun.

translations.ron: Zis-am: "Păzi-voi căile mele, ca să nu păcătuiesc eu cu limba mea;

verses.translation: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I set a guard on my mouth, while the sinner stood in my presence.

translations.ron: Pus-am gurii mele pază, când a stat păcătosul împotriva mea".

verses.translation: I was dumb, and humbled myself, and kept silence from good words; and my grief was renewed.

translations.ron: Amuţit-am şi m-am smerit şi nici de bine n-am grăit şi durerea mea s-a înnoit.

verses.translation: My heart grew hot within me, and a fire would kindle in my meditation: I spoke with my tongue,

translations.ron: Înfierbântatu-s-a inima mea înăuntrul meu şi în cugetul meu se va aprinde foc.

verses.translation: O Lord, make me to know mine end, and the number of my days, what it is; that I may know what I lack.

translations.ron: Grăit-am cu limba mea: "Fă-mi cunoscut, Doamne, sfârşitul meu,

verses.translation: Behold, thou hast made my days old; and my existence is as nothing before thee: nay, every man living is altogether vanity. Pause.

translations.ron: Şi numărul zilelor mele care este, ca să ştiu ce-mi lipseşte".

verses.translation: Surely man walks in a shadow; nay, he is disquieted in vain: he lays up treasures, and knows not for whom he shall gather them.

translations.ron: Iată, cu palma ai măsurat zilele mele şi statul meu ca nimic înaintea Ta.

verses.translation: And now what is my expectation? is it not the Lord? and my ground of hope is with thee. Pause.

translations.ron: Dar toate sunt deşertăciuni; tot omul ce viază.

verses.translation: Deliver me from all my transgressions: thou hast made me a reproach to the foolish.

translations.ron: Deşi ca o umbră trece omul, dar în zadar se tulbură.

verses.translation: I was dumb, and opened not my mouth; for thou art he that made me.

translations.ron: Strânge comori şi nu ştie cui le adună pe ele.

verses.translation: Remove thy scourges from me: I have fainted by reason of the strength of thine hand.

translations.ron: Şi acum cine este răbdarea mea? Oare, nu Domnul? Şi statul meu de la Tine este.

verses.translation: Thou chastenest man with rebukes for iniquity, and thou makest his life to consume away like a spider's web: nay, every man is disquieted in vain. Pause.

translations.ron: De toate fărădelegile mele izbăveşte-mă; ocară celui fără de minte nu mă da.

verses.translation: O Lord, hearken to my prayer and my supplication: attend to my tears: be not silent, for I am a sojourner in the land, and a stranger, as all my fathers were.

translations.ron: Amuţit-am şi n-am deschis gura mea, că Tu eşti Cel ce m-ai făcut pe mine. Depărtează de la mine bătăile Tale.

verses.translation: Spare me, that I may be refreshed, before I depart, and be no more.

translations.ron: De tăria mâinii Tale, eu m-am sfârşit. Cu mustrări pentru fărădelege ai pedepsit pe om
